Watch out #enghchat #literacies @ncte @hypothes_is #edu307 @boffosocko
https://quickthoughts.jgregorymcverry.com/2019/04/02/dogtrax-budtheteacher-dr_jdean-tellio-mdfunes-cogdog-johnjohnston
we might find
heights of meaning
in close reading
of poetry long
before we
write, in spite

of
enthusiasm
no schism
has risen
to cause a
cataclysm
splitting
reading and
writing
and
writing and
reading
so let's dissect,
keep your hose at bay,
a poem
and put together our
own Frankenstein in the
Marginalia
#smallpoems
